newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson Const jumps after general offer.
newsitem.headline: Dickson Const jumps after general offer.

text.p: Shares of Dickson Construction International Ltd rose on Monday following Turbo Act International Ltd's announcement that it would make a general offer for the company at HK$0.63 per share.
Shares in the construction and civil engineering group, which had been suspended since November 5, rose HK$0.15 or 27.78 percent to HK$0.69 in mid-morning trade.
"Expectations of a possible future asset injection, which will result in an increase in net asset value, fueled demand for the shares," said one sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Turbo Act said it had agreed to buy 20.63 percent of the issued shares of Dickson Construction from chairman Ho Kee Kung, giving it and related parties a 46.02 percent stake.
It said it would subsequently make a general offer at HK$0.63 per share for all outstanding shares.
